Speaker: Veyra
Text: Winterhold has been losing travelers on the road. The last report names an Altmer scholar, Nirelda Aurantil.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Begin with the College. An old expulsion record may tell you whether the tower is rumor or refuge.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: I'll ask the College for her record.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: What do you expect me to find?
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A rival died in a magical accident. That is a description, not a verdict.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Find out what she studied, and what the road has been paying for it.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: Aurantil. That file stays sealed unless you give me a reason worth the ink.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: Travelers are dying on the Winterhold road. That is not yet proof she did it.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: (Persuade) The road is becoming a graveyard.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: (Bribe) Perhaps the Arcanaeum could use a donation.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: I am the Arch-Mage. Give me the record.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Then I will find another lead.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: Then bring me something less convenient than suspicion. The widow in town may have it.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: The file remains here. Your dead do not become evidence because you are angry.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: Gold is a language the College pretends not to speak. Take the record, and return it without blood.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: Of course, Arch-Mage. Try not to become a chapter in it.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: The file concerns an accident, not a confession. Remember that distinction.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: Nirelda Aurantil was expelled eleven years ago. Her rival died during a destructive experiment.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: The statements disagree about intent. The College filed the uncertainty and called it closure.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: What does the file say about her tower?
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Who else saw the accident?
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: I'll take the uncertainty with me.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: Hollowfrost Spire. A private tower on the tundra. The College has no claim there now.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: If she is still alive, she may prefer the cold to another hearing.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: Students, a master, and one apprentice who changed her account twice.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Urag
Text: No sentence in that file tells you what happened inside her head.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Thyra
Text: My Brandr took the south road to Dawnstar. His horse came home. He did not.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Thyra
Text: Some nights there is a light on the tundra. Hollowfrost Spire, they call it. Nobody honest lives there.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Did Brandr ever meet Nirelda?
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: I'll find the tower.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Thyra
Text: He said a woman asked about the color of his blood. He thought she was a healer until she stopped listening.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Thyra
Text: That is all I know. Do not turn my grief into a story that makes you brave.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The record and the widow point to one place. Hollowfrost Spire is not a verdict. It is where your questions become dangerous.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Frost. Poison. Blade. Silence. Four ways for a body to stop arguing with the world.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: You may solve the order, or show me what you do when a door refuses to open.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Use the notes to set the four pillars.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Force the mechanism with fire.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Disarm the runes by hand.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: You read before touching. A modest virtue. The order is frost, venom, blade, silence.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: The door opens. Do not mistake comprehension for permission.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: A destructive solution. Efficient, loud, and careless with the structure.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: The order was written in the margins. You could have read it.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: You disarm the runes one pin at a time. Patience is a form of knowledge, I suppose.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: The tower admits you. I will adjust my notes.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Joric
Text: Help me... please...
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Do not touch him. He is almost finished. I need the exact moment.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: You have entered my tower. Now you are another variable.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Heal the traveler.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Let him die and watch Nirelda's notes.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Step between them and end the observation.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: You ruined eleven days of observation. And yet the man is breathing.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Mercy is not a measurement. That may be why it interests me.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: There. The pupils change before the breath ends. Did you see it?
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: You watched a person become a note. You may regret how familiar that feels.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: You interrupt the observation without healing him. An inelegant mercy.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Still, you chose a limit. That is data of a sort.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: You call yourselves servants of the dark. I call you a household with knives.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Answer two questions honestly. I will hear what you offer. Fail, and I will test your last breath instead.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: The Void is a belief, not a fact I can prove.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: We serve Sithis. We do not own what comes after death.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: I do not know what waits. I know why I choose.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Good. You have not dressed uncertainty as a theorem. One point, perhaps.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: A creed and a boundary. Better than certainty. One point.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Choice is observable. Motive is less so. I will count the answer.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Why kill when study would leave the subject intact?
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Because study without consent is already a kind of taking.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: For gold.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Because killing is honest.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Consent. An inconvenient variable. Two points.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Mercenary. Honest, perhaps. Not sufficient.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: A clean answer can still be a lazy one.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: What would your family make of me?
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: A sister, if you accept limits.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: A tool, useful until it is not.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: A subject for the Arcanum.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Limits. I have not enjoyed them since Alinor. A useful answer.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: A clear answer. It does not make me want to kneel.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: You would make a specimen of me. At least you admit it.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Very well. I will come and study your family, provided I may be corrected.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: That is the closest thing to surrender I have offered in years.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: You have answers. I have not heard a reason to trust the hands holding them.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Let us see whether your magic is more precise than your ethics.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Enough. Your strength is clearer than your answers. I yield. I will come, but I will not call that agreement.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: The letter concerns a poison called Whisperbane. The buyer signed only with the initials L.M.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Two doses. An old woman and a Redguard in the north. I thought it was a family quarrel.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: You were paid to poison my family.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: You did not know who the doses were for.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Your family? Then my research has acquired a very inconvenient audience.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: I sold a method, not a target. The distinction is suddenly less comfortable.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: I knew the doses, not the faces. Ignorance is not innocence, but it is not intent either.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Laboratory, exile, or grave? You have turned my own question back toward me.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: The poison was meant for your family. Decide what you will do with the woman who made it.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Come to Dawnstar. You may build an Arcanum under our rules.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Take her back to the College.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Tolfdir has agreed to receive her.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Leave Skyrim and take your research with you.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Your research ends here.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: An invitation with conditions. Accepted. I will need shelves, fireproof tables, and permission before I open anything.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Do not mistake curiosity for obedience. I am choosing the arrangement.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Back to the College, to be judged by people who faint at a nosebleed.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Very well. Let them decide whether an exile is more dangerous than a fire.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Exile again. At least this time I choose the direction.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: I will leave the poison behind. The questions are mine to carry.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: All that knowledge, and you still prefer a closed book.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Nirelda joined us. She yielded after the fight.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Nirelda joined us after the examination.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: I handed Nirelda to the College.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Nirelda left Skyrim.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Nirelda is dead.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: She accepted a boundary after trying to burn through it. Make sure the Arcanum has doors, not only shelves.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Her fire is a discipline. Her curiosity is not a license.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The College may call that justice. It may also call it convenient. Your choice is recorded.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The Arcanum will wait for another mind.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: She leaves with questions and without our walls. That is safer for some people, and lonelier for her.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Do not confuse distance with an answer.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A waste. Knowledge does not make a death less final.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: We will remember the question, not pretend we solved it.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: L.M. ordered poison for an old woman and a Redguard. Their deaths were meant to look natural.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Keep the letter with the earlier fragments. A pattern can be deliberate without being understood.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Does this identify the hand behind it?
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Then the next contract may be watched too.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Player
Text: Keep it in the ledger.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: It gives us initials and a method. Names require more than suspicion.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Assume the road is being watched. Do not let caution become paralysis.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: The room is smaller than my tower. The questions are better.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: I will ask before I experiment. You may quote me on that.
Notes: Enhanced draft; inherited Q03 V2 baseline. CK conditions remain to be wired.

Speaker: Selveni
Text: You are asking about Aurantil? Read the margin, too.
Notes: New College witness; no Vanilla record change.

Speaker: Player
Text: You signed one of these statements.

Speaker: Player
Text: What did you see after the blast?

Speaker: Player
Text: Why did your account change?

Speaker: Player
Text: I have enough. Keep your margin.

Speaker: Selveni
Text: I was an apprentice. I saw smoke, a broken focus crystal, and Nirelda pulling me clear.

Speaker: Selveni
Text: The master wanted certainty. I had only a room full of witnesses who remembered different fire.

Speaker: Selveni
Text: She chose a person before she chose an explanation. I have never forgiven her for making that difficult.

Speaker: Selveni
Text: The margin is a copy, not a verdict. It still names the focus crystal and the first witness.

Speaker: Player
Text: Give me the copied margin.

Speaker: Player
Text: Leave it here. The College can keep its own doubt.

Speaker: Selveni
Text: Take it. Return it if the College asks what you learned.

Speaker: Selveni
Text: Then take the road with only Urag's version. It is safer for the College.

Speaker: Player
Text: The south road has a cold silence to it. Search the waystation.

Speaker: RoadSurvivor
Text: Do not go to the tower. The woman with the fire was not taking coin.

Speaker: Player
Text: Treat the survivor first.

Speaker: Player
Text: Inspect the burned pack.

Speaker: Player
Text: Follow the scorch marks.

Speaker: RoadSurvivor
Text: The frost took my brother. She measured his breath until the fire went out.

Speaker: Player
Text: You are alive. Tell the College what you saw when you can.

Speaker: Player
Text: The pack is burned from the inside. No coin was taken.

Speaker: RoadSurvivor
Text: Take the token. It was my brother's. Nirelda took nothing else.

Speaker: Player
Text: The scorch marks stop where the snow begins. Someone wanted the trail to end.

Speaker: RoadSurvivor
Text: The light moved uphill. I never saw a face, only a hand bright with fire.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A witness, a token, and a road that refuses to name its dead.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: The pillars open the first chamber. The second responds to what you carry.

Speaker: Player
Text: Use Selveni's focus fragment.

Speaker: Player
Text: Break the chamber before it can test us.

Speaker: Player
Text: Wait and watch the mechanism.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: You brought a fragment from the College. It remembers the shape of my first mistake.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Fire is not a key merely because I wield it.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Patience gives the tower time to decide whether you are worth the stairs.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: The frostfire ward is quiet. Continue, but do not touch the empty crystal cradle.

Speaker: Player
Text: Before we continue, show me the names in your ledger.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: Names, dates, responses. I released three subjects when they asked. I kept the others when they did not.

Speaker: Player
Text: Read the page marked 'refused'.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: The page is blank. I could not make a measurement from a refusal.

Speaker: Player
Text: You wrote down consent after the fact.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: I wrote down the moment I understood that consent changes the experiment.

Speaker: Player
Text: Close the ledger.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: A boundary without an explanation is still a boundary. You keep surprising me.

Speaker: Player
Text: The letter was hidden behind a false panel.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: A countermark. L.M. sent it through another hand.

Speaker: Player
Text: Keep the seal with the fragments.

Speaker: Player
Text: Burn the seal. It teaches us nothing yet.

Speaker: Nirelda
Text: It teaches you that distance can be part of a murder.

Speaker: Player
Text: Then we keep the distance in mind.
